## Points on the line

Every <Term t="math.fx-real-number">real number</Term> is a point on the number line, for example $\frac{1}{2}$, $-3, 0$ and $\sqrt{2}$. On the exam paper it is <Zh>實數</Zh>, and $\text{實數}$ is fine inside math, as is `實數` in code.

<Predict id="p1" answer={2} />

<StudentAsks q="What about $\pi$?">
$\pi$ is a real number too; it just can't be written as a fraction.
</StudentAsks>

<Misconception id="math.fx-misconception" />

<ExamChinese>

</ExamChinese>
